title: Clinic Queue
summary: Self check-in kiosk and live queue screen for busy outpatient clinics.

data.text: At Fernwhistle Health, Odile built the check-in kiosk and waiting room screen used in outpatient clinics. Patients scan their appointment letter, confirm two details and take a seat.
The kiosk was designed with patients and reception staff in the room: large type, high contrast, one question per screen, and a clear way to ask a human for help at every step.

data.alt: Clinic Queue kiosk screen with a single large question
data.caption: One question per screen, readable from a wheelchair.

data.text: Median check-in time dropped from eleven minutes at the front desk to four, and reception staff got time back for the patients who needed them.
